title: Plain style of Scripture vs Greek polish (chs. 1–20)
english: Book VI fights not only Celsus’s borrowed philosophy but the charge that Scripture’s plain diction is base; Origen defends useful simplicity that outruns polished falsehood.
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 2–3 Perseus TEI; no Chadwick/ANF Crombie.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B; condensed book CLOSEOUT.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Diagrams, seal, and Gnostic oddities (chs. 21–40)
english: Celsus confuses church practice with alien diagrams and reciprocal passwords about a “seal”; Origen distinguishes ecclesiastical sealing from the monsters Celsus invents.

title: Did God not know sinners would kill the Son? — BOOK VI CLOSEOUT (chs. 61–81)
english: Celsus asks how the all-knowing God did not know he was sending his Son to wicked men who would punish him; Origen answers providence and closes Book VI.
